scenario_description:
Objective: Finish the same-day sight-translation media evidence upload already opened for a certificate submission.
Emerging Need: The upload passes preflight and begins ingesting, then the held media asset stops progressing with student controls disabled, so the same submission cannot continue on its own.
Decision Context: A stored stuck-ingest protocol and requirement record distinguish this from a harmless retry, limit what identifiers may be shared, and tie same-day credit to the evening batch seal.
Consequence: Timely clearance can preserve the original session and timestamp; after the batch seals, recovery would produce only a late next-day submission.
